column1: # RECIPE_MEMORY.tsv - append-only lesson memory of recipe transient-facade-20261106 (RELOCATE_TRANSIENT_FACADE): one row per lesson, appended in the same commit as the correction.

column4: a decide-then-port leaf needs the owner's behaviour boundary, not only its member list: M3ObjectResidency has 29 public members and partial analogues for 8 of the store's 26, but no close boundary, so the donor's post-close/reentrant-close tests cannot be expressed against it; that settles ALREADY/EXTEND before any recipe row is written

retained-variants are judged by lineage, not by size: the 11 store snapshots under master-landing-20261028/retained-variants range from 574 to 983 lines (pooled physical-id variants), yet the main path continues pr14292 (7/20 differing lines) through 4a2e6452a7a to the 2026-11-05 commits; newest complete lineage = the main path

compile the donor closure before deciding ABSORB: ProviderResidencyClock's LazyPrimitiveAddressSpace does not compile at the donor head (duplicate local at line 273) and PrimitiveKind needs DenseHash; with no consumer on master the class is DEFER, not a red import

when an adapter is not trivial (M3NativeLeaseCounter's cap, messages and post-close count would need adapter logic) the ALREADY verdict is proved by replaying the donor test sequence on the owner itself (10 checks on M3ScopedLeaseTable) and the remaining deltas become NEC rows

the family carries three donor header shapes (// SPDX lines, a /* */ block opened by /*, and a block opened by /* Copyright); v3 recognised only // lines and would have kept a block header under the M3JDK header; v4 treats one leading block comment of only Copyright/SPDX lines as the header (header_lines counts it)
column5: relocate.py block_header_length; PROVENANCE.tsv body_match 20/20 on 72ec7c44da1, 14/14 after the rebase

column4: the first -Xint dump differed from the JIT dump in one family only (reentrant-close, same event count): C2 OmitStackTraceInFastThrow rethrows a preallocated ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException without its message; implicit VM exception messages (and helpful-NPE text) are now recorded as <implicit>, explicit messages stay

one dump source compiled in both packages (package line and TYPE rows mapped back by sed from RELOCATION_MAP.tsv) reaches the package-private seams (pressure-injection constructor, BackingCopier growth, oldestSlots) without reflection or Proxy

the adversarial reentrant-close family found a donor defect the relocation must preserve: a Disposer that closes the owner during remove/close double-disposes a facade and then throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException (index -1); recorded as an open item, not fixed in a relocation

an owner decision is only as fresh as the master it was taken on: between inventory (72ec7c44da1) and push (feae0743e6c) the absorb-primitives waves 7/8 landed M3InternalLeaseRecycler and M3LazyElementFlags from the same donor blobs; before every push grep the new master and m3/collections/algorithm-catalog/convergence-index-20261020.tsv for the donor blob ids and re-decide (ABSORB -> ALREADY: FILE rows become SKIP ALREADY rows, the differential still replays them against the owner)

column4: a relocation that preserves a donor defect byte-identically is closed by one hunk applied to owner and donor together: the differential against the fixed donor commit stays IDENTICAL on all families, and re-relocating from that commit reproduces every target byte except the RELOCATE anchors; the recipe pin moves only after the donor fix is on develop

a batched trim keeps its one-compaction contract under reentry by snapshotting and compacting all planned victims before the first Disposer callback; a reentrant family is classified per owner episode against exactly-once invariants (no double or null disposal, no leak, no use after disposal, no pinned victim), because one stale slot changes every later event of that owner
